Dear Parents,
We have a limited number of pre-loved school sweaters available in sizes 4, 5, and 6 to give away. These sweaters are in excellent condition and are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
The swears will be placed in a carton box at the center foyer. Parents who are interested can come and take a look at them during dispersal.
Regards,
[REDACTED]
Headmistress Montessori
